mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopCqDt*/ SELECT PO.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQ.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, CQ.DESCRIPTION, CQ.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER, CQ.SPECIFICATION, CQ.LIST_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = CQ.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE, CQ.UNIT_PRICE FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMPOHD PH, ICOMCQDT CQ WHERE 1=1 AND PO.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PO.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND PO.BUYER = PH.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = PH.PO_NO AND PO.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = CQ.BUYER AND PO.BUYER = CQ.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AND PO.CONTRACT_NO = CQ.CONTRACT_NO AND PO.CONTRACT_SEQ = CQ.CONTRACT_SEQ AND PO.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO

/*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopPoHd*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, H.BUYER AS BUYER, H.PO_CREATE_DATE, (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_NAME, H.PURCHASER_NAME AS PO_USER_NAME, H.PO_NO AS PO_NO, (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, (SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.COM_CODE = H.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, H.AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT AS AGENT_AMT, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = D.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE, D.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE_CODE, D.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, H.PO_TTL_AMT AS PO_AMT, H.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, H.PO_REMARK AS REMARK, H.PURCHASER_ID AS PURCHASER_ID, D.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, D.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, H.SELLER AS SELLER, DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',D.WAREHOUSE_CODE,D.BUYER) AS TR_BUYER FROM ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPODT D, ICOMPRDT R WHERE D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND H.BUYER = D.BUYER AND H.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ

/*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopIvDt*/ SELECT PD.BUYER, PD.PO_NO, PD.PO_SEQ, DECODE(PD.PROCESS_TYPE, '0', IV.INV_NO, WD.INV_NO) AS INV_NO, PS.DS_SEQ, PD.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = PD.PROCESS_TYPE)||(DECODE(NVL(IH.PARCEL_YN, PH.PARCEL_YN),'Y','(택배)','(자차)')) AS PROCESS_TYPE, DECODE(PD.PROCESS_TYPE, '0', IV.INV_QTY, WD.INV_QTY) AS INV_QTY, PD.ITEM_QTY, PS.CD_QTY, PD.UNIT_MEASURE, PD.ST_DATE, PD.RD_DATE, PS.DS_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = IH.PARCEL_COM_CODE) AS AGENT_PARCEL_COM_NAME, IH.PARCEL_INV_NO AS AGENT_PARCEL_INV_NO, (SELECT REPLACE(TEXT5,'param',IH.PARCEL_INV_NO) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = IH.PARCEL_COM_CODE) AS AGENT_PARCEL_REAL_URL, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = WD.DELIVERY_COMPANY) AS TR_PARCEL_COM_NAME, WD.DELIVERY_NO AS TR_PARCEL_INV_NO, (SELECT REPLACE(TEXT5,'param',WD.DELIVERY_NO) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND CODE = WD.DELIVERY_COMPANY) AS TR_PARCEL_REAL_URL, PD.ADD_DATE AS DATE1, PD.ADD_TIME AS TIME1, PS.ADD_DATE AS DATE2, PS.ADD_TIME AS TIME2, IV.ADD_DATE AS DATE3, IV.ADD_TIME AS TIME3, /* 고객사나 사용자 입장에서는 클릭 시점이 궁금하지는 않을 것이기 때문에 실적등록일 기준 */ DECODE(IH.PARCEL_YN, 'Y', TO_CHAR(IH.PARCEL_ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(IV.DELIVERY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD')) AS DATE4, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(IV.DELIVERY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DATE4_1, /* 협력사의 자차 or 택배에 따라 보이거나 안보임 */ IV.WMS_GR_DATE AS DATE5, '' AS TIME5, (SELECT DECODE(SUBSTR(TEXT2, 0, 2), '중앙', 'HUB', SUBSTR(TEXT2, 0, 2)) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = PD.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS WAREHOUSE_INIT_NAME, (SELECT TO_CHAR(HUB_GR_CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = PD.BUYER AND PO_NO = PD.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PD.PO_SEQ AND S_INV_NO = IV.INV_NO AND S_INV_SEQ = IV.INV_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS DATE5_HUB, (SELECT TEXT7 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'W001' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT1 = (SELECT DEPT_CENTER FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = PD.BUYER AND PO_NO = PD.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PD.PO_SEQ AND S_INV_NO = IV.INV_NO AND S_INV_SEQ = IV.INV_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS HUB_NAME, /* 고객사나 사용자 입장에서는 클릭 시점이 궁금하지는 않을 것이기 때문에 실적등록일 기준 */ DECODE(NVL(TRIM(WD.DELIVERY_NO),''), NULL, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(WD.DELIVERY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), '', TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(WD.DELIVERY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD'), TO_CHAR(NVL(WD.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE, WD.PARCEL_ADD_DATE), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') ) AS DATE6, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(WD.DELIVERY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DATE6_1, /* 센터의 자차 or 택배에 따라 보이거나 안보임 */ (CASE WHEN NVL(WD.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE, WD.PARCEL_ADD_DATE) IS NOT NULL THEN 'TR배송완료' WHEN IV.WMS_GR_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'TR입고완료' WHEN IV.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN '협력사배송완료' WHEN IV.ADD_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN '배송중' WHEN PS.ADD_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN '수주접수' ELSE '발주' END) AS STATUS_TEXT, DECODE(PD.PROCESS_TYPE, '0', IH.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, WD.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL) AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, IH.PARCEL_YN AS PARCEL_YN, PD.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT PD, ICOMPOHD PH, ICOMIVDT IV, ICOMIVHD IH, WMSIVDT WD, ICOMPORS PS WHERE 1=1 AND PD.BUYER = PH.BUYER AND PD.PO_NO = PH.PO_NO AND PD.BUYER = IV.BUYER(+) AND PD.PO_NO = IV.PO_NO(+) AND PD.PO_SEQ = IV.PO_SEQ(+) AND IV.BUYER = IH.BUYER(+) AND IV.INV_NO = IH.INV_NO(+) AND PD.BUYER = WD.BUYER(+) AND PD.PO_NO = WD.PO_NO(+) AND PD.PO_SEQ = WD.PO_SEQ(+) AND PD.BUYER = PS.BUYER(+) AND PD.PO_NO = PS.PO_NO(+) AND PD.PO_SEQ = PS.PO_SEQ(+) AND PD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PH.STATUS <> 'D' AND IV.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND IH.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND WD.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND PS.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND PD.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PD.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PD.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} ORDER BY DS_SEQ

/*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopPoMn*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MN.NOTICE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS NOTICE_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND CODE = MN.TYPE) AS TYPE_NAME, MN.AGENT_REMARK, MN.RE_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = MN.RE_PROCESS_TYPE) AS RE_PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, MN.CH_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = MN.CH_PROCESS_TYPE) AS CH_PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, MN.PARCEL_YN, DECODE(MN.PARCEL_YN, 'Y', '택배', '자차') AS PARCEL_YN_TEXT, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MN.RE_DS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RE_DS_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MN.CH_DS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CH_DS_DATE, TO_CHAR(MN.SEQ) AS SEQ, MN.TYPE, MN.PO_SEQ, MN.DS_SEQ, MN.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY FROM KEP_PO_MNG MN WHERE 1=1 AND MN.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND MN.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND MN.PO_SEQ IN (#{st_po_seq}, '000000') AND MN.STATUS = 'S'

/*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopList1*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, P.BUYER_ITEM_NO, P.ADD_DATE AS PO_ADD_DATE, NVL(P.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(P.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, TRUNC(NVL(P.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(P.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS UNIT_AMT, P.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER, P.LEGACY_PO_NO, P.PO_SEQ, P.REF_PR_NO, P.RD_DATE, NVL(P.AGENT_PRICE,0) AS AGENT_PRICE, P.UNIT_MEASURE, TRUNC(NVL(P.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(P.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS AGENT_AMT, P.SELLER_ITEM_NO, P.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, P.DESCRIPTION, P.SPECIFICATION, P.PO_REMARK, P.STATUS
FROM ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H WHERE P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND H.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND H.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} ORDER BY P.PO_SEQ

/*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopList2*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(MN.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND CODE = MN.TYPE) AS TYPE_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGSTTS' AND CODE = MN.STATUS) AS STATUS_TEXT, DECODE(MN.TYPE, 'D', '[기존]:'||(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = MN.RE_PROCESS_TYPE)|| ', [변경]:'||(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = MN.CH_PROCESS_TYPE)||DECODE(MN.PARCEL_YN,'Y','(택배)','')||', '||MN.AGENT_REMARK, MN.AGENT_REMARK ) AS AGENT_REMARK, MN.ATOA_REMARK, MN.KEP_REMARK, DECODE(SUBSTR(MN.ADD_USER_ID,1,3), 'FTP', '시스템', (SELECT DECODE(A.COM_CODE, 'KRKORE0001', A.USER_NAME_LOC, '협력사(' || A.USER_NAME_LOC || ')') FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.USER_ID = MN.ADD_USER_ID)) AS ADD_USER, DECODE(SUBSTR(MN.CONFIRM_USER_ID,1,3), 'FTP', '시스템', (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = MN.CONFIRM_USER_ID)) AS CONFIRM_USER, TO_CHAR(MN.CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS CONFIRM_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MN.NOTICE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS NOTICE_DATE, DECODE(LENGTH(MN.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY), 13, DECODE(SUBSTR(MN.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, 0, 1), '1', 1, 0), 0) AS SELLER_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, MN.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY FROM KEP_PO_MNG MN WHERE MN.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND MN.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND MN.PO_SEQ IN (#{st_po_seq}, '000000') AND MN.STATUS <> 'S' ORDER BY MN.ADD_DATE DESC, MN.CONFIRM_DATE DESC

/*selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopRptUrl*/ SELECT Y.QRY_STR1 , Y.QRY_STR2 , Y.QRY_STR3 , Y.QRY_STR4 , X.SLG_ID , X.DEFAULT_RPT_URL FROM ( SELECT 'P06-0000002' AS SLG_ID -- ID 하드코딩 ,'RD_06_S_001_83' AS DEFAULT_RPT_URL --디폴트 유알엘 하드코딩 , 추후 변경 /kr/epro/buy/sheet/inv_prn.jsp FROM DUAL --한건도 조회되지 않는 것 방지 ) X, ( SELECT B.COL01_DATA QRY_STR1 , B.COL02_DATA QRY_STR2 , B.COL03_DATA QRY_STR3 , B.COL03_DATA QRY_STR4 , A.SLG_ID FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID --default url을 가져오기 위해 아우터조인 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} --고객사 회사코드 AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000002' -- ID하드코딩 ) Y WHERE 1=1 AND X.SLG_ID = Y.SLG_ID(+)
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMpSoIssueManageRemark */ INSERT INTO KEP_PO_MNG ( BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, DS_SEQ, SEQ, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, AGENT, STATUS, TYPE, NOTICE_DATE, OLD_NOTICE_DATE, RE_PROCESS_TYPE, CH_PROCESS_TYPE, PARCEL_YN, RE_DS_DATE, CH_DS_DATE, AGENT_REMARK, ATOA_REMARK, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, SELLER_IMAGE_KEY ) ( SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, DS_SEQ, ( SELECT NVL(MAX(SEQ),0)+1 FROM KEP_PO_MNG MN WHERE MN.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MN.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND MN.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND MN.DS_SEQ = A.DS_SEQ ) AS NEW_SEQ, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, AGENT, 'S' AS STATUS, #{st_type} AS TYPE, #{st_notice_date} AS NOTICE_DATE, #{st_notice_date} AS OLD_NOTICE_DATE, RE_PROCESS_TYPE, CH_PROCESS_TYPE, PARCEL_YN, RE_DS_DATE, CH_DS_DATE, AGENT_REMARK, ATOA_REMARK, #{st_user_id} AS ADD_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, #{st_user_id} AS CHANGE_USER_ID, SYSDATE AS CHANGE_DATE, SELLER_IMAGE_KEY FROM KEP_PO_MNG A WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND DS_SEQ = #{st_ds_seq} AND SEQ = #{st_seq} )

'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ( SELECT DECODE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EXCCMPY' AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT4 IS NULL), 0, ( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'CMSM' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE2 = '1' AND CODE1 = ( SELECT SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = ( SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq}) ) ) ), AND CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT4 IS NULL), 0, ( SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'CMSM' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE2 = '1' AND CODE1 = ( SELECT SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = ( SELECT CMS_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code}) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq}) ) ) ), #{st_user_id} ) FROM DUAL ) ), (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND SYS_TYPE='KA' )' ||CHR(10)|| '-협력사 거부내용: ' || #{st_req_remark} ||CHR(10)|| '-운영자 처리내용: ' || #{st_remark_atoa}, (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE='KRKORE0001' AND SYS_TYPE='KA' AND mapper.select: /* selectMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPopPreAutoProcess1 */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM ICOMPORS A, KEP_PO_MNG B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.STATUS = 'S' AND B.TYPE = 'A' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: /* updateMasterMpSoIssueManageRemarkPreAutoProcess2 */ UPDATE KEP_PO_MNG A SET A.STATUS = 'A', -- 자동처리 A.CHANGE_USER_ID = 'FTP', A.CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, A.CONFIRM_USER_ID = 'FTP', A.CONFIRM_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.TYPE = 'A' -- 수주미접수 AND A.STATUS = 'S'

/* updateMasterMpSoIssueClearPrdt */ UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET STATUS = 'R' WHERE 1=1 AND (BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ) IN (SELECT BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND STATUS <> 'D') AND STATUS <> 'D'

/* updateMasterMpSoIssueClearPodt */ UPDATE ICOMPODT SET STATUS = 'R', COMPLETE_MARK = 'N', DS_FLAG = 'N', DS_DATE = NULL, DS_DELAY_REASON = NULL, DO_QTY = 0, SEND_DATE = ' ', SEND_TIME = ' ', CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND STATUS <> 'D'

/* updateMasterMpSoIssueClearPrhd */ UPDATE ICOMPRHD A SET A.STATUS = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND STATUS IN ('C','R')),0,'D','R'), A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND (A.BUYER, A.PR_NO) IN (SELECT BUYER, PR_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND STATUS <> 'D') AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
